summary: This document defines extensions to the Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol so it can set up different types of Layer 2 VPNs in a unified way. It builds on the L2TP model in which a session connects two Layer 2 circuits attached to peering L2TP access concentrators.

eli5.summary: A tunnel can join two separate private networks as if they shared one cable. This adds the settings needed so such tunnels can be set up in one consistent way.
